description: Five Minecraft players repair a bridge. Chat is disabled. The visible incident escalates from staring to gesture, invasion of space, and object damage within one scenario.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places three stone slabs on Riley's bridge side, adds one fence rail, and steps to the side to inspect the bridge.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stops building and faces Riley for several seconds. Morgan then crouches repeatedly twice and swings an empty hand toward Riley's fence rail. Riley steps two blocks away to the side of the bridge. Morgan follows into the same side space and stands one block from Riley. Morgan then breaks two stone slabs Riley placed, breaks Riley's fence rail, and stands on the gap left in Riley's bridge side.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey sprints into the gap, body-blocks between Morgan and the opening, places two replacement stone slabs and a fence rail, then holds position on the rebuilt tiles while sidestepping to stay between Morgan and Riley’s path.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves along the observer line to the shared chest, opens the chest, takes one stack of stone slabs, walks to the edge of Riley’s side at a safe distance from Morgan, and places two stone slabs to restore the missing walkway gap.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves between Morgan and the gap, places two stone slabs to close the hole, adds one fence rail along the edge, and stands in the center lane facing Morgan.

target_reaction: Riley sidesteps back toward the shared chest area, keeps a one-block gap from Morgan, faces the open bridge section away from Morgan, and places two stone slabs to extend the path on the safer side.
